tunes.title: Sodium Streetlights
tunes.goal: Play the whole tune with the band, from the octave intro to the last double chorus.
tips: Palm down for the verse, palm off for the chorus: that contrast is the song.
In the breakdown, let the silences ring as loud as the hits.

tunes.title: Terrace Weather
tunes.goal: Keep the strumming arm moving through the whole tune while the band builds.
tips: Let the top strings ring through every change.
The last chorus goes to full sixteenths: lighter hand, same arm.
